europe_now.title: Massive Drone Attack Hits Moscow During Russian Elections
europe_now.summary: Ukraine targeted Moscow with a major drone attack focusing on a refinery as Russia's elections concluded. The military strike added significant tension to the final day of the weekend vote.

europe_now.title: German States Hold Elections Amid Political Pressure on Merz
europe_now.summary: Voters in two German regions went to the polls in elections that pose a fresh political challenge for Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The vote carries heightened stakes as the far-right AfD pursues potential regional gains.
